name: io.github.iowarp/spack-mcp
title: CLIO Spack
description: Structured Spack discovery and installation tools for scientific agents

tools.name: spack_find
tools.description: List installed Spack packages matching an optional constraint. No matches is a successful result with count=0 and packages=[].

tools.name: spack_locate
tools.description: Resolve one unique installed Spack spec. Copy spack_locate.output.load_spec unchanged into one element of jarvis_run.input.spack_specs; do not derive or pass an executable path from the returned prefix. An absent package returns the structured not_installed error, enriched with whether a recipe is available to install.

tools.name: spack_search
tools.description: Search recipe availability across every registered Spack repo -- broader than spack_find/spack_locate, which only see what is already installed.

tools.name: spack_info
tools.description: Describe one recipe's versions, variants, and description; falls back to parsing package.py and says so when spack info is unavailable.

tools.name: spack_install
tools.description: Install one Spack spec with explicit reusable or fresh concretization. Captures the full build log to disk and returns the install prefix on success.

resources.name: spack_capabilities
resources.description: Describe the stateless Spack contract exposed by this server.

prompts.name: prepare_spack_package
prompts.description: Guide an agent through deterministic package preparation.
